short_summary: A provisional utility patent filing (Application #63/707,441) for the HealthRate Institution Index was submitted on 10/15/2024 by inventor Tim Michaels, filed by Jeff Sage on behalf of HealthRate Inc, with the correspondence address 701 S. Carson St Suite 200, Carson City, NV 89701.
long_summary: The document is an electronic acknowledgement receipt from the United States Patent and Trademark Office confirming the filing of a Utility-Provisional patent application (Application #63/707,441) on October 15, 2024. The invention, titled "HealthRate Institution Index," describes a method for determining the relative Provider Price Index across U.S. health systems. The filing lists Tim Michaels as the inventor, Jeff Sage as the filing representative, and HealthRate Inc as the applicant with its headquarters at 701 S. Carson St Suite 200, Carson City, NV 89701. The application type is identified as Utility-Provisional.

company_name.answer: The documents list HealthRate Inc as the applicant/company name.
